about: Whitchurch-Stouffville is a town in York Region, on the Oak Ridges Moraine northeast of Markham. Stouffville is the main urban centre; hamlets such as Ballantrae, Gormley, and Bloomington sit among farms, kettle lakes, and conservation land. GO Transit and Highway 404 make it a growing commuter town with a still-rural north. About 50,000 people live in Whitchurch-Stouffville.
